name: Smoke Bridge
description: The Smoke Bridge, which relays a paired smoke alarm's alarms to Insteon groups.

operatingFlags.name: programmingLock
operatingFlags.label: Programming lock
operatingFlags.description: The bridge can't enter linking mode.

operatingFlags.name: ledOnTransmit
operatingFlags.label: Blink LED when sending
operatingFlags.description: The LED blinks when the bridge sends an Insteon message.

operatingFlags.name: ledOff
operatingFlags.label: LED off
operatingFlags.description: The LED is off, except in linking mode.

operatingFlags.name: heartbeat
operatingFlags.label: Heartbeat
operatingFlags.description: The bridge sends a heartbeat to group 0x0A.

operatingFlags.name: cleanupReport
operatingFlags.label: Send cleanup reports
operatingFlags.description: The bridge sends a success report after each group broadcast.

readings.name: databaseDelta
readings.label: ALL-Link database changes
readings.description: A count that goes up whenever the ALL-Link database changes. It clears when the device loses power.

extendedCommands.name: readSmokeAlarmId
extendedCommands.description: Reads the Insteon ID of the smoke alarm the bridge is paired with.

notes: The configuration byte is 0x62 by default: LED blink on transmit, heartbeat and cleanup reports on.
The Smoke Bridge Developer Notes describe LED On, 0x09, as making the bridge enter linking mode on power-up. Its example and the flag table read it as turning the LED on.
readSmokeAlarmId reads the bridge's ALL-Link database at address 0x0307.
